reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts with the worst-case range rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the handler adds one field on top of scheduleModel.toExternal.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type in api-models; putting it in the handler rather than a model mapper is acceptable since only the list exposes it.

scope.why: Touches only the list handler, its type and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Small, typed and delegates the rule to the shared helper, so future rule changes flow through automatically.
